title: Drop Clause: Enhancing Performance, Robustness and Pattern Recognition Capabilities of the Tsetlin Machine
venue: AAAI 2023 (Thirty-Seventh AAAI Conference on Artificial Intelligence)
new_feature: Drop clause: each clause is switched off with probability p for a complete training epoch (dropout analogue), adding stochasticity that improves accuracy, training speed, interpretability and robustness.

extraction_notes: Camera-ready AAAI version of arXiv 2105.14506 (same numbers; table numbering differs: Table 2 = image p-sweep, Tables 3-5 = NLP baselines; no Kuzushiji-MNIST footnote). Inference time stated as 2.3 s per 1000 samples (NLP, GTX 1080) and 1.5 s per 1000 images (CIFAR-10, V100). Code URL is an anonymized review repo. All Table 1/5 drop-probability sweeps included. Baselines in Tables 3,4,7 are quoted from literature. MR split sizes not stated. Std only given for peak image results (100 runs).
